cards.ex: After the concert, the band received words of praise from all the critics.
cards.exUz: Konsertdan keyin, guruh barcha tanqidchilardan maqtov so'zlarini oldi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yaxshi ish qilgani uchun aytilgan xursandchilik va minnatdorchilik so'zlari.

cards.ex: The teacher commended Sarah for her excellent essay.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchi Sarani a'lo inshosi uchun maqtadi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yaxshi ish qilgani uchun rasman maqtash yoki e'tirof etish.

cards.ex: The manager took the employee to task for being late again.
cards.exUz: Menejer xodimni yana kechikkani uchun tanqid qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir xato yoki noto'g'ri ish qilgani uchun qattiq tanqid qilish.

cards.ex: The new restaurant got rave reviews, so we decided to try it.
cards.exUz: Yangi restoran juda yuqori baholar oldi, shuning uchun biz uni sinab ko'rishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Film, kitob yoki spektakl uchun juda yaxshi, hayratomuz sharhlar.

cards.ex: The boss gave the project a thumbs up, so we can proceed.
cards.exUz: Boshliq loyihani ma'qulladi, shuning uchun biz davom eta olamiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani ma'qullash yoki qo'llab-quvvatlash belgisi.

cards.ex: The critic gave the movie a slash and burn review.
cards.exUz: Tanqidchi filmga juda qattiq tanqidiy sharh berdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani juda qattiq va shafqatsizlarcha tanqid qilish.

cards.ex: His 'congratulations' felt like damning with faint praise.
cards.exUz: Uning 'tabriklari' sovuq maqtovdek tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Unchalik qiziq bo'lmagan yoki aslida tanqid bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan maqtov.

cards.ex: I found his tone quite patronizing and offensive.
cards.exUz: Men uning ohangini juda kamsituvchi va haqoratli deb topdim.
cards.uzDef: O'zini boshqalardan ustun his qilish va ularni kamsitish orqali gapirish.

cards.ex: The experiment failed, so it's back to the drawing board.
cards.exUz: Tajriba muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi, shuning uchun boshidan boshlash kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganida, qayta boshlash kerak.

cards.ex: The reviews for the play were a mixed bag; some loved it, some hated it.
cards.exUz: Spektakl uchun sharhlar aralash natija edi; ba'zilar uni yaxshi ko'rdilar, ba'zilar nafratlandilar.
cards.uzDef: Ba'zi qismlari yaxshi, ba'zilari esa yomon bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The coach was singing the team's praises after their victory.
cards.exUz: Murabbiy g'alabadan keyin jamoani maqtab yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir juda maqtash, uning fazilatlarini ta'kidlash.

cards.ex: Winning the award was a real feather in her cap.
cards.exUz: Mukofotni yutish uning uchun haqiqiy faxr manbai bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Erişilgan yutuq yoki muvaffaqiyat, faxrlanish uchun sabab.

cards.ex: By all accounts, the new manager is doing a great job.
cards.exUz: Hamma aytishicha, yangi menejer a'lo ish qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hamma aytganiga ko'ra yoki hamma fikriga ko'ra.

cards.ex: We need to hold them accountable for their mistakes.
cards.exUz: Biz ularni o'z xatolari uchun javobgar qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir o'z xatti-harakatlari uchun javobgar qilish.

cards.ex: His work isn't always up to scratch.
cards.exUz: Uning ishi har doim ham talablarga javob bermaydi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan standartlarga mos keladigan.

cards.ex: The service at that hotel is second to none.
cards.exUz: U mehmonxonadagi xizmat ko'rsatish tengsiz.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshisi; taqqoslashga arziydigan hech kim yo'q.

cards.ex: The comedian gave the politician a roasting at the awards show.
cards.exUz: Komik aktyor mukofot topshirish marosimida siyosatchini qattiq tanqid qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir omma oldida qattiq tanqid qilish yoki masxara qilish.

cards.ex: The report was seen as a whitewash designed to protect the company.
cards.exUz: Hisobot kompaniyani himoya qilish uchun mo'ljallangan yashirish sifatida ko'rildi.
cards.uzDef: Xatolarni yoki yomon ishlarni yashirishga urinish.

cards.ex: The critics were singing the young actor's praises to the skies.
cards.exUz: Tanqidchilar yosh aktyorni osmonga ko'tarib maqtashardi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yoki biror narsani juda yuqori darajada maqtash.

cards.ex: He's trying to get back in the boss's good books.
cards.exUz: U boshliqning hurmatiga qaytishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir hurmatiga sazovor bo'lish, yaxshi munosabatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'm in the doghouse with my wife for forgetting our anniversary.
cards.exUz: Men yubileyimizni unutganim uchun xotinimning g'azabidaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir g'azabiga yoki noroziligiga duchor bo'lish.

cards.ex: This is a golden opportunity to invest in the company.
cards.exUz: Bu kompaniyaga sarmoya kiritish uchun oltin imkoniyat.
cards.uzDef: Nodir va juda yaxshi imkoniyat.

cards.ex: Her harsh words really cut me to the quick.
cards.exUz: Uning qattiq so'zlari meni haqiqatan ham dardimga tegdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir juda xafa qilish yoki qattiq ranjitish.

cards.ex: The accident was a wake-up call for him to drive more carefully.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisa unga ehtiyotkorroq haydashga ogohlantirish bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning jiddiyligini tushunishga yordam beradigan voqea.

cards.ex: He's on thin ice after his repeated mistakes.
cards.exUz: U takroriy xatolaridan keyin xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Xato qilganingiz sababli muammoga tushish xavfi borligi.

cards.ex: My boss is always nitpicking at my work.
cards.exUz: Mening boshlig'im har doim mening ishimda mayda xatolar topishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Faqatgina mayda xatolarni topishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The joke fell flat, and nobody laughed.
cards.exUz: Hozir hech qanday ta'sir ko'rsatmadi va hech kim kulmadi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erisha olmaslik, kutilgan natijani bermaslik.

cards.ex: She's sticking to her guns despite the criticism.
cards.exUz: U tanqidga qaramay, o'z fikrida qat'iy turibdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizga qat'iy ishonib, uni himoya qilish.

cards.ex: The company's decision to cut salaries felt like a slap in the face.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning maoshlarni qisqartirish qarori haqoratdek tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Haqoratli yoki juda xafa qiladigan harakat yoki so'z.

cards.ex: The report pulls no punches about the company's failures.
cards.exUz: Hisobot kompaniyaning muvaffaqiyatsizliklari haqida ochiq gapiradi.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlarni yashirmasdan, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytish.
